suite: G9 Staff Portal Management + G10 Client Portal
observations: SALES_REP and SOLUTION_ARCHITECT can open portal sessions, but only ADMIN/PRESALE_LEAD can be the first one on an APPROVED proposal (G9-04)
FINDING: VIEWER can read the staff session list (200), exposing client email + name of every portal session; the portal read routes check authentication and organization only, never role

FINDING: POST /portal-materials returns a payload without isShared/createdBy (id, title, description, fileName, fileUrl, mimeType, createdAt); the caller must re-GET the list to confirm the sharing default
FINDING: the client view returns ALL 10 sheets, including internal ones (Assumptions & Dependencies, Risk Management RAID, Appendices & Case Studies); the plan expected only client-facing sheets
5000-character question passed the validator with status 502 (guard is checked before the AI call)
G10-07 covers the AI-unavailable path only; answer quality and citations[] provenance need the AI service running on :8000.

results.title: Bootstrap: organizations, portal roles, APPROVED proposals in both tenants
notes: approved: ebd84998-e467-4a11-bd41-67fe92295037 (pricing sheet seeded), c6fb18bc-0640-4d63-bff8-ad403cf11203, 9fdadde0-a7e0-4685-a1d9-032007e95576, foreign 386a2f68-6904-4079-b391-8a85c3b07deb; IN_REVIEW 1c5f0568-9d1d-4184-b593-bfa25e5fa767

results.title: Create session contract: 201, opaque accessToken handed out once, no token hash in any payload
notes: 201 with {id, proposalId, organizationId, clientEmail, clientName, expiresAt, accessToken}; default TTL 168.0h
expiresInHours=24 honored (24.0h)
accessToken appears only in the create response; list payloads carry no credential

results.title: Session role and tenant guards: VIEWER 403, anonymous 401, foreign proposal 404, smuggled organizationId ignored
notes: VIEWER create -> 403 (Your role cannot create client portal sessions.)
payload organizationId ignored: the session stays in the caller scope

results.title: Session input guards: proposalId, clientEmail, clientName and expiresInHours boundaries; only real proposals 404
notes: 18 invalid create-session payloads all answered 400 with the error envelope
expiresInHours 1 and 720 accepted while 0/721/2.5/NaN are refused; unknown proposal 404, non-object body 400

results.title: Status precondition: non-approved 409, first session flips APPROVED -> SENT_TO_CLIENT and audits both steps
notes: IN_REVIEW proposal -> 409 (Only an approved proposal can be shared with a client.)
SALES_REP cannot be the first session on an APPROVED proposal (403) and the status is untouched
first session: APPROVED -> SENT_TO_CLIENT, audit CLIENT_PORTAL_SESSION_CREATED, PROPOSAL_SHARED_WITH_CLIENT, CLIENT_PORTAL_SESSION_CREATED, PROPOSAL_STATUS_CHANGED, PROPOSAL_STATUS_CHANGED

results.title: List portal sessions: shape, ordering, commentCount, revoked/lastAccessed columns and no credential
notes: 8 sessions listed newest-first with expiresAt/revokedAt/lastAccessedAt/commentCount and no token hash
cross-tenant 404, malformed 400, unknown 404, anonymous 401

results.title: Portal materials: HTTPS-only fileUrl, isShared defaults to false, field limits, role and status guards
notes: 201, isShared=false confirmed through the staff list (the create response omits the column)
16 invalid material payloads answered 400; fileUrl is HTTPS-only (5 URL schemes refused)
VIEWER 403, unknown/DRAFT proposal 404, malformed proposalId 400, foreign 404, anonymous 401

results.title: Staff material list and delete: unshared rows visible with isShared/createdBy, 204 then 404, tenant and role guards
notes: 3 materials listed for staff including the unshared rows, newest-first
204 delete, replay/mismatch/foreign/unknown 404, malformed 400, VIEWER 403, anonymous 401

results.title: Revoke session: 204 + audit, the token stops working at once, replay 404, role and tenant guards
notes: a revoked token stops authenticating reads and writes on the very next call
audit trail: CLIENT_PORTAL_SESSION_CREATED + CLIENT_PORTAL_SESSION_REVOKED for the same session id
revoke is tenant-scoped: another organization cannot revoke (404)

results.title: Client token guards: missing, staff JWT, garbage and foreign proposal ids all answer 401, never 500
notes: 4 client routes without a token answered 401 in the JSON envelope (no HTML, no 500)
a staff JWT replayed as a portal token is refused (401)
malformed/nil uuid and a token used on another tenant proposal all 401
token of proposal A rejected on proposal B and vice versa, reads and writes

results.title: Shared proposal view: client fields exposed, internal columns withheld
notes: view fields: id, title, version, status, totalCost, currency, estimatedTimelineWeeks, sheets; 10 sheets returned
a DRAFT/IN_REVIEW proposal is unreachable through the client route

results.title: lastAccessedAt is stamped on every authenticated client call and untouched on failures
notes: lastAccessedAt followed the calls (2026-10-21T09:51:58.575Z -> 2026-10-21T09:51:59.027Z)
a rejected token does not touch lastAccessedAt

results.title: Client comments: author comes from the session, validation, trimming, ordering and isolation
notes: 201 with authorName/authorEmail taken from the portal session (E2E Client Corp <client-20261021095127@example.test>)
8 invalid comment payloads answered 400; the 5000-character boundary accepted
6 comments returned oldest-first
body fields cannot forge another session or proposal

results.title: Client materials list exposes only shared rows and hides staff columns
notes: 1 of the staff-visible materials reached the client; the unshared row was withheld

results.title: Client PDF export: %PDF bytes, headers and the same tenant guards
notes: %PDF 1787 bytes, exact Content-Length, attachment disposition
guards 401; the export leaves the proposal untouched

results.title: Client questions: guards before any AI call and a sanitized failure while the AI service is offline
notes: 5 invalid question payloads answered 400 before any AI call; anonymous 401, cross-proposal 401
AI offline: 502 with the error envelope and no internal leak - SUCCESS PATH NOT COVERED

results.title: Expired, revoked and unshared-again sessions all stop authenticating
notes: expired session: read, list and write all 401 with nothing stored
revoked session answered 401 on the next call
client access is cut the moment the proposal leaves SENT_TO_CLIENT/ACCEPTED (401 on all four routes, never 500)
REJECTED cannot jump back to SENT_TO_CLIENT directly (409); the documented path is through DRAFT
access returns for the surviving session once the proposal is re-shared
expired fixture session removed (1 row)

results.title: Client surface hygiene: no credential or internal leak, no staff-cookie dependence, no client-side writes
notes: 5 client routes: no 5xx, no credential or internal leak
client routes ignore staff cookies: session cookie alone 401, portal token 200
no client-side write verb is mounted on the portal surface; ACCEPTED proposals remain readable

results.title: Teardown: every probe session revoked, every probe material deleted
notes: 10 sessions on the shared proposal, all revoked
all probe materials deleted from both shared proposals
the revoked client token is dead at the end of the run
